jobs.description: Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.comThe PositionBoehringer Ingelheim is seeking a highly motivated Postdoctoral Research Scientist to advance the application of Artificial Intelligence (AI), Agentic AI systems, and predictive computational technologies in late-stage pharmaceutical development. The position focuses on transforming the development of solid oral dosage forms through the integration of mechanistic modeling, hybrid digital twins, advanced analytics, and autonomous AI-driven development workflows.As successful candidate, you will work in a highly motivated, small team of experienced prediction technology experts directly integrated into daily development business. You will be able to integrate your academic knowledge and further broaden your expertise. The work will be at the intersection of pharmaceutical sciences, process engineering, data science, and artificial intelligence. The overall objective is to establish next-generation computational frameworks that accelerate process understanding, optimization, scale-up, technology transfer, and commercial manufacturing readiness.This role provides a unique opportunity to shape how AI and autonomous scientific agents are applied across the pharmaceutical development lifecycle and to contribute to the future of digital and data-driven CMC development.This position is limited for 2 years.This position is part time eligible with 80 %.This Position is limited for 2 years.Note: To make it easier to find our job advertisements, we use the usual designation "postdoc". Of course, this advertisement is not only addressed to applicants directly after completing their doctorate, but to all qualified candidates.Tasks & responsibilities- One of your key responsibilities will be to develop predictive models and hybrid digital twins for pharmaceutical manufacturing processes.- In regard to process understanding and optimization, you will apply mechanistic modeling, machine learning, and advanced analytics to support scale-up and technology transfer activities.- Moreover, you will design and implement Agentic AI and multi-agent systems to support scientific decision-making, experimental planning, knowledge extraction, and process optimization.- In addition, you will evaluate emerging AI technologies and identify opportunities for their application in pharmaceutical development.- Furthermore, you will generate scientific insights that contribute to improved process performance, robustness, and efficiency across development and manufacturing.- You will be a contact person for cross-functional collaboration with formulation scientists, process engineers, manufacturing experts, and data scientists in multidisciplinary project teams.﻿Requirements- PhD in Pharmaceutical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Process Systems Engineering, Data Science, Computer Science, or a related scientific discipline.- Strong expertise in at least one of the following areas: pharmaceutical process development, mathematical modeling, machine learning and artificial intelligence, or process systems engineering.- Experience with scientific programming languages such as Python and the ability to work with complex datasets and computational tools.- Ability to collaborate effectively in multidisciplinary and international research teams.- Fluent English communication skills; willingness to learn German.- Knowledge of pharmaceutical manufacturing processes and familiarity with mechanistic, data-driven, or hybrid modeling approaches. Experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic AI, or multi-agent systems is considered an advantage.With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.Want to learn more? About the roleWe're looking for a Principal C++ Engineer to own the factory simulation of our next game. The game is built in Unreal Engine 5 , but the simulation will be self-contained and written in raw C++.Players will place hundreds of thousands of machines, belts, pipes, and more across a large world, and every one of them has to deterministically update on every player's device in a co-op session.You'll design that simulation module from the ground up as one of the first engineers on a new game team , working closely with the Engineering Team Lead and the Game Design department.Your responsibilities• Design and build a deterministic factory simulation that scales to hundreds of thousands of player-placed buildings• Own the sim architecture: data layout, tick model, threading, and serialisation format• Work with the Networking Engineer so the sim and co-op are designed together, not bolted on later• Set and meet the CPU performance budget for the sim on our minimum specification target• Review code and mentor other engineers on C++ and architectureAbout youYou will likely have:• Experience in professional C++ environments where you have architected, implemented, and maintained performant modules which are built on by other engineers, and lived with the consequences of your design choices• Deep knowledge of data-oriented design, multithreading, and performance, including CPU profiling and applying algorithmic complexity-based analysis to select the right data structures• Built a deterministic or lockstep system, or can show how you'd approach one• A track record of mentoring engineers and making architectural decisions in writing that others could follow and challengeIn addition, you may have:• 2+ shipped game titles• Worked on a factory, automation or simulation-heavy game• Worked in Unreal Engine, especially with Mass Entity or a custom ECS in UnrealIf you match most of this and the problem excites you, please apply.What we offer• Fully Remote: We employ directly inside Germany• Flexible working hours!• Paid overtime, on the rare occasions it happens• A hardware budget to ensure you have the ergonomic setup and hardware you need to work comfortably• A monthly personal growth allowance for courses, books or other learning material• Focus days to research or learn new skills• A yearly team gathering to meet and collaborate in person• A yearly salary review to keep your pay in line with the market, and an automatic increase of 2% per yearNext Steps & How to ApplyPlease apply via our recruitment agency 8bit via https://8bitplay.com/jobs/principal-c-engineer/• A one-hour technical conversation with the Engineering Team Lead about work you have done• A one-hour meeting with our HR and either our Founder/CEO or our Studio Producer, depending on availability, to assess shared values, how we will work together, and culture add• A second technical round in a format we pick together, based on what we need to assess for the specific role, taking no more than 2-3 hours of your time in total• A casual, unscored conversation with a group of people you'll be working with closely to learn more about us and for the team to learn more about you• An offer callWe give you a decision within a few working days of each stage, and we aim for the whole process from the first interview to an offer to take four weeks or less.For this role:• The first technical conversation covers systems you've built and how you would build ours• For the second technical round, we decide together on either:• A whiteboarding session where we collaborate to design the broad strokes of the simulation• A take-home code review (you should not need more than two hours), with your feedback then presented in real timeWe are happy to discuss any requested accommodation to the above process.About usWe are a small indie studio that makes factory and automation games. jobs.description: At Bayer we’re visionaries, driven to solve the world’s toughest challenges and striving for a world where ,Health for all, Hunger for none’ is no longer a dream, but a real possibility.
